Devon L.: Want to do 'next team to score' as a tiebreaker? I'll take home team. $1 on the line.
Maya S.: How do we submit picks? Spreadsheet? DM?
Ethan R.: spreadsheet — quicklink: https://tinyurl.com/office-halftime-props
Priya K.: added my pick to the sheet. name: Priya K. pick: odd / tiebreaker: away team
Devon L.: done. put $1 in the envelope labeled "props" on the kitchen counter. :moneybag:

OpsBot: A new poll 'Halftime Props — Cold Brew Cup' has been created by Ethan R. Link: https://tinyurl.com/office-halftime-props

```
- One main prop: halftime total points (even/odd)
- Tiebreaker: next team to score
- Entry closes 10 minutes before kickoff
- Prize: winner gets the cold brew pot + glory. second place: bragging rights
```
Priya K.: who’s bringing cups? I can grab paper ones.
